title: No Need to Pay Attention: Simple Recurrent Neural Networks Work! (for Answering “Simple” Questions)
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical optimization of a factoid question-answering system using recurrent neural networks (RNNs). It evaluates performance based on accuracy on the SimpleQuestions dataset and latency on real-world queries from an entertainment platform. There is no mention or analysis of religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
